title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How the People's Court Shall Determine the Issue of a Guarantor's Signature on a Payment Reminder Notice after the Guarantee Period Has Expired

articles.content_en:
April 14, 2004
Supreme People's Court
Reply on How the People's Court Shall Determine the Guarantor's
Signing on the Reminder Notice After the Expiry of the Guarantee Period
Fa Shi [2004] No. 4
To the Higher People's Courts of Yunnan, Hebei, and Sichuan:
Your Petitions, namely Yun Gao Fa [2003] No. 69 "Petition on How to Determine the Nature and Liability of a Guarantor Who Signs on a Reminder Notice after the Expiry of the Guarantee Period," Ji Min Er Qing Zi No. 1 [2003] "Petition on How to Determine the Civil Liability of a Guarantor Who Seals on the 'Notice of Confirmation of Creditor's Rights Transfer' of China Great Wall Asset Management Corporation after the Expiry of the Guarantee Period," and Chuan Gao Fa [2003] No. 266 "Petition on the Legal Effect of a Guarantor and a Debtor Who Sign or Seal on a Reminder Notice on the Same Day after the Expiry of the Guarantee Period," have been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
According to the provisions of the Guarantee Law of the People's Republic of China, if the creditor fails to claim the guarantee liability from the guarantor according to law before the expiry of the guarantee period, the guarantee liability shall lapse. After such lapse, if the creditor notifies the guarantor in writing to assume the guarantee liability or repay the debt, and the guarantor signs on the reminder notice, the People's Court shall not determine that the guarantor continues to assume the guarantee liability. However, if the content of such reminder notice complies with the provisions of the Contract Law and the Guarantee Law on the formation of a guarantee contract, and the guarantor signs to confirm it, so that a new guarantee contract may be deemed to have been formed, the People's Court shall determine that the guarantor assumes liability in accordance with the new guarantee contract.
This is the reply.
